remarks: Discover the perfect blend of modern living and urban convenience in this stunning end unit located in the heart of South Norwalk (SoNo), CT. Featuring 9 ft. ceilings and large windows on two sides, this unit is bathed in natural light and offers views of the Norwalk River and Veteran's Memorial Park.   The galley kitchen, with its sleek honed granite countertops and cozy breakfast nook, is bright and inviting. Additional highlights include gleaming hardwood floors, new windows throughout, and the convenience of an in-unit stacking washer and dryer.   Step outside your front door to enjoy SoNo's premier amenities-top-notch restaurants, the upscale SoNo Collection shopping center, the Maritime Center, and the South Norwalk train station, all within walking distance. Commuters will love the easy access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway, while beach lovers can reach Calf Pasture Beach in just 2.5 miles.   For investors, this unit is also available to rent, offering a great opportunity to generate income. On-street parking and public garage rentals are available for added convenience.
